DRAFT · for the Chief of Staff · not sent · send after Note 5 is answered 
From: Jonathan Paul Zschoche, attorney-in-fact of Patricia Keesey Zschoche 
To: Atty. Bonifacio T. Barandon, Jr. 
Date: ____ October 2026 
Re: Civil Case No. 26-360, Princess and Jomil Torralba

Atty. Barandon,

Their Answer lists Princess to testify to "the absence of any notice of revocation or dispute prior to the later demand letter and complaint," and Jomil to "the absence of any notice of dispute prior to the filing of the case." Princess's affidavit adds that in all her years there she met no opposition from anyone. The records of Mrs. King's cases say otherwise, in their own words and in official records.

**Princess.** Barangay San Roque blotter entry 2763, certified on 20 May 2020, records that on 19 May 2020 she came to the Kings' construction with a policeman and four tanod to stop the work, and said "May usapin pa yan."

**Jomil.** In July 2020 he answered a criminal complaint about this land before the Provincial Prosecutor. The resolution of 28 July 2020 records his defence: he was "merely acting on instructions of the owner of the property in the person of Gloria Balane thru Nelly Juntilla." The resolution of 16 September 2020, which said ownership must be settled by a court, was mailed to the respondents on 23 September 2020. In December 2020 he posted ₱180,000 in cash bail in Criminal Case 20-6030 over the same land. In June 2021 he and Nelly Juntilla sued Mrs. King for damages, and their lawyer received her Answer, with the Bicol Post notices attached, on 9 July 2021.

**How I suggest it is used.** Short, one-fact questions on cross in January, each answered by a public record in your hand. If they deny, the certified records come in on rebuttal. Nothing here needs to be shown before they testify.

I would like to request certified copies quietly now: the prosecutor's file for both 2020 complaints, which holds Jomil's and Juntilla's counter-affidavits and a lawyer's letter for Gloria dated 11 February 2020, and the barangay blotter pages for May 2020. The question list and page references are ready when you want them.

**What I need from you by 28 October:** (1) your agreement that I request those certified copies now; (2) whether you prefer these points on cross of Princess and Jomil in January, or held for rebuttal only.

With respect, 
Jonathan Paul Zschoche
